steps.title: Validate the selected experiment
steps.explanation: Accept a fixed experiment only. Browser input cannot choose an arbitrary telemetry destination or add tools.

steps.title: Start the local OTLP receiver
steps.explanation: Bind a private loopback port chosen by the OS. The classroom receiver keeps bounded per-run data in memory; it is not a production Collector distribution.
steps.narration: Step 2. Bind a private loopback port chosen by the OS. The classroom receiver keeps bounded per-run data in memory; it is not a production Collector distribution. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Enable the selected signals
steps.code:
CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY: enabled ? "1" : "0",
    CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA: selected("traces") ? "1" : "0",
    OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER: selected("traces") ? "otlp" : "none",
    OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER: selected("metrics") ? "otlp" : "none",
    OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER: selected("logs") ? "otlp" : "none",
steps.explanation: Select OTLP exporters for each signal and enable beta tracing where needed. Off explicitly disables telemetry.
steps.narration: Step 3. Select OTLP exporters for each signal and enable beta tracing where needed. Off explicitly disables telemetry. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Configure OTLP and short intervals
steps.code:
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL: "http/json",
    OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: endpoint,
    OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS: `Authorization=Bearer ${token}`,
    OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL: "1000",
    OTEL_LOGS_EXPORT_INTERVAL: "1000",
    OTEL_TRACES_EXPORT_INTERVAL: "1000",
steps.explanation: Use standard OTLP HTTP/JSON for inspectable native exports. The lesson slide uses HTTP/protobuf, another supported encoding. One-second intervals reduce short-run batching windows.
steps.narration: Step 4. Use standard OTLP HTTP/JSON for inspectable native exports. The lesson slide uses HTTP/protobuf, another supported encoding. One-second intervals reduce short-run batching windows. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Preserve the private process environment
steps.explanation: Preserve PATH and private credentials while replacing inherited exporter routing with this per-run local configuration. Isolate SDK state in the disposable workspace.

steps.title: Receive and decode native OTLP
steps.explanation: Parse actual JSON batches received over HTTP, sanitize account identity, then flatten each signal without inventing spans or metrics.

steps.title: Retain span IDs and resource tags
steps.explanation: Preserve native parent links and resource attributes. The browser derives its tree from those IDs. Hook spans require separate detailed beta tracing, which this app does not enable.
steps.narration: Step 9. Preserve native parent links and resource attributes. The browser derives its tree from those IDs. Hook spans require separate detailed beta tracing, which this app does not enable. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Export the finished host span
steps.explanation: Export the real host span through the official OpenTelemetry exporter to the same receiver. Verify matching trace and parent IDs in Linked mode.
steps.narration: Step 10. Export the real host span through the official OpenTelemetry exporter to the same receiver. Verify matching trace and parent IDs in Linked mode. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Attach encoded classroom attributes
steps.explanation: Use a fictional classroom identity and percent-encode its space in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. The decoded enduser.id can filter tool-result events.
steps.narration: Step 11. Use a fictional classroom identity and percent-encode its space in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. The decoded enduser.id can filter tool-result events. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Make content logging explicit
steps.code:
OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS: mode === "content" ? "1" : "0",
    OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS: mode === "content" ? "1" : "0",
    OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT: mode === "content" ? "1" : "0",
    OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES: "0",
    CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_DIAG_STDERR: "1",
steps.explanation: Content mode opts in to synthetic prompt, tool details and tool output. Raw API bodies remain disabled. Default structural telemetry can still contain identifiers; the receiver sanitizes account attributes.

steps.title: Compare delivery with agent completion
steps.explanation: Keep receiver requests, diagnostics and SDK results as independent evidence. A successful agent response does not prove telemetry was accepted; the rejected-endpoint mode demonstrates this.
